source_note: Vendor-linked drawing archive includes a touch-labelled STEP. Used as mechanical reference, not proof of 1.54G assembly fit.
ui: Actual SD/Wasm app, WAMR and LVGL capture at 200x200. Upper hold opens pending request; upper tap cancels; lower key cycles five reviewed-card pages. No messages or emergency calls.
case_basis: Vendor PDF envelope retained; case corners softened to R8 and edge radii to 1.6 mm for this concept. Board-only STEP preserved as reference.
new_parts: Rounded R8 shell derived from the vendor envelope. A continuous cord threads through the separate rear clip aperture. No front HELP button. Breakaway clasp, sealing, antenna clearance and wearable validation remain engineering work.
